transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
I guess… I’ve been feeling like I’m not really cut out for the level I’m at. Like I somehow convinced people I can handle more than I actually can, and I keep beating myself up over it.
Do you often feel nervous or on edge about being found out or not meeting expectations?

Yeah… I guess so. It’s more like I keep thinking I’m not really senior material, and that I somehow fooled people into thinking I can handle more than I actually can. Then I just… beat myself up over it.
Do you often feel anxious?
I mean… sometimes, I guess. I don’t know if I’d call it anxious all the time. It’s more just… I get tense about whether I’m keeping up.
Have you been feeling sad or down most of the time lately?
Yeah… most days lately, I think. It’s just this kind of heavy, low feeling. Like I’m getting through work and home, but everything feels… dulled.
Do you have any recurring thoughts that you can't seem to get out of your head?

Yeah… it’s mostly that same thing. I keep thinking I’m not really cut out for the senior role, like I somehow convinced everyone I could handle it when maybe I can’t. It just kind of loops in my head.
Do you find it difficult to stop thinking about this idea that you're not cut out for your role, even when you try to focus on other things?
Yeah… it’s hard to shut off. Even when I’m trying to work or do something else, it comes back to me feeling like I’m not really senior material… like I fooled people into thinking I could handle it.
Do you feel nervous around other people at work or in social situations?
I don’t know… not really, I guess. I mean, I’m not that social at work, but I wouldn’t say I’m especially nervous around people.
Do you find that you're not enjoying things you used to enjoy?
Yeah… a little. I mean, I usually like grilling on weekends, fishing, putting on a record or whatever. Lately I just kind of… don’t bother. The stuff’s there, I just leave it.
Have you noticed any change in your weight recently?
A little, maybe. I haven’t really been eating much… just a few bites here and there, sometimes skipping supper. My belt feels a bit looser, but I’m not trying to lose weight or anything.
Do you often have trouble sleeping due to worrying or feeling overwhelmed?
Yeah… sometimes. I’ll wake up too early thinking about client tickets and then I can’t really get back to sleep. Other times I sleep enough, I guess, but still feel pretty worn out.
Do you often feel guilty about things that have happened?

Yeah… I guess so. Mostly I keep thinking I’m not really cut out for the senior stuff at work. Like I somehow convinced people I could handle more than I actually can. It’s… hard not to beat myself up over it.
Have you ever had a sudden feeling of intense fear or discomfort that reached a peak within minutes?
I don’t think so. I mean, I get stressed, but not like a sudden wave of fear that peaks like that… not that I’ve noticed.
Do you worry about things other than work or your ability to perform in your role?
Not really sure. I mean, normal stuff, I guess… bills, family things sometimes. But it doesn’t feel like the same kind of thing. Mostly I notice it with work.
Do you think your worries about not being cut out for your role would stop or significantly decrease if you were to leave your current job or switch to a different role?
I’m not sure. Maybe it would ease up some, but… I think the feeling would probably follow me. It’s more that I keep thinking I fooled people into believing I’m more capable than I am.
Do you think your worries and fears are excessive and uncontrollable?

Yeah… I think maybe they are excessive. I know I keep going over it more than I should. It’s like I keep beating myself up that I’m not really senior material, like I somehow fooled everyone into thinking I can handle more than I really can. It’s hard to shut off.
Are you having trouble completing tasks or responsibilities outside of work due to these feelings?

A little, yeah. I’m still getting to work and handling the main stuff, but outside of that I’ve kind of pulled back. I double-check myself a lot, and with friends or family I just… don’t really trust my mood or my judgment lately, so I avoid some things.
Are these feelings and thoughts affecting your relationships with family and friends?

Yeah… a bit. I’ve been pulling back from people. I still show up for work and do what I need to, but with friends and family I’m more hesitant. I don’t really trust my mood or my judgment lately, so I just keep to myself more.
Are you having difficulty taking care of your basic needs, like personal hygiene or eating regularly, because of these feelings?
A little, I guess. Hygiene’s mostly okay, but eating’s been kind of off. I’ll just grab a few bites or skip supper. My belt’s a bit looser, and I’m not really trying to lose weight.
Have you had to take any days off work or significantly reduce your work hours due to these feelings?
No, not really. I’m still making it to work and doing my hours. I just… have to double-check myself more, and outside of work I’ve been pulling back from people.
Do you often feel anxious when you're not thinking about work or your role?
I’m not sure I’d call it anxious, exactly. Maybe uneasy sometimes, when things get quiet… but I haven’t really paid attention to it that way.
